queries: WITH g AS (SELECT p.throws, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM manager_award ma JOIN player p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id GROUP BY p.throws), s AS (SELECT throws, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM g), a AS (SELECT throws, cnt, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(share - avg_share) AS avg_excess FROM a WHERE share > avg_share

assumptions.assumption: player_id is unique in player, so the inner join does not duplicate award rows. A NULL throws value forms its own group.
The average share across hands is the simple mean of the group shares over all groups, including the NULL group. The average share in the output is the mean over only the kept hands.

assumptions.assumption: The average share across hands is the simple mean of the per-group shares over all groups, including the NULL group. This equals 1 divided by the number of groups.
The returned average share and average excess are computed only over the kept hands. The excess is each kept hand's share minus the all-group average share.
